title: StreamersTip Tippy Planner action family v1
description: Canonical catalog of Tippy Planner operators. Only reschedule_plan is open. Other actions are documented, not shipped. Do not invent a giant edit-planner tool. Flutter must copy this file as-is; do not implement unopened actions.

actions.purpose: Create a new plan from an approved preview (goal, schedule, campaign, game, platform, or idea).
Change plan-level settings: dates, cadence, titles, formats, priorities, platforms.
Change a specific task or item.
Reversible removal from active planning. Default recommendation for removal.
Permanent deletion. Stronger confirmation than archive.
Propose a recovery schedule from stale or overdue work. Prefer over creating more when workload is behind.
